[D5:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
[D5:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
[D5:3] Jolene: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
[D5:4] Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
[D5:5] Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
[D5:6] Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
[D5:7] Jolene:  Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
[D5:8] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?
[D5:9] Jolene: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.
[D5:10] Deborah: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?
[D5:11] Jolene: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!
[D5:12] Deborah: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
[D5:13] Jolene: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
[D5:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes
[D5:14] Deborah: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
[D5:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
[D5:16] Deborah: You're awesome too! Take care!
[D5:17] Jolene: Stay safe!

[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book and a calculator on a table
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
[D4:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[D4:6] Deborah: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
[D4:7] Jolene: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
[D4:8] Deborah: So, what are your career aspirations now?
[D4:9] Jolene:  I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
[D4:10] Deborah:  I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
[D4:11] Jolene: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
[D4:12] Deborah: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
[D4:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose
[D4:13] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
[D4:14] Deborah: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
[D4:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair
[D4:15] Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
[D4:16] Deborah: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.
[D4:17] Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
[D4:18] Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
[D4:19] Jolene: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it
[D4:20] Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
[D4:21] Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
[D4:22] Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
[D4:23] Jolene: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting! 
[D4:24] Deborah: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together. 
[D4:25] Jolene: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
[D4:26] Deborah: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
[D4:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table
[D4:27] Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
[D4:28] Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
[D4:29] Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
[D4:30] Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
[D4:31] Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
[D4:32] Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:33] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:36] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

Session date: 3:56 pm on 6 June, 2023
[D13:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result!
[D13:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back
[D13:2] Deborah: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off. 
[D13:3] Jolene:  I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.
[D13:4] Deborah: Now that you've reached this big milestone, what do you have planned next?
[D13:5] Jolene:  I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience. These are my new colleagues!
[D13:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture
[D13:6] Deborah: What's been the best part of it so far?
[D13:7] Jolene: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects. It's so fulfilling to see my ideas come to life.
[D13:8] Deborah: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?
[D13:9] Jolene: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.
[D13:10] Deborah:  How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
[D13:11] Jolene: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.
[D13:12] Deborah: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?
[D13:13] Jolene: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.
[D13:14] Deborah:  Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.
[D13:15] Jolene: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna.
[D13:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched
[D13:16] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.
[D13:17] Jolene: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.
[D13:18] Deborah: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?
[D13:19] Jolene: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.
[D13:20] Deborah: Glad they've been helpful for you!
[D13:21] Jolene: No idea how I would've survived without them!
[D13:22] Deborah: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming. 
[D13:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D13:23] Jolene:  I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?
[D13:24] Deborah: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body. 
[D13:25] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!
[D13:26] Deborah:  If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!
[D13:27] Jolene: See you!

Session date: 9:34 am on 24 August, 2023
[D21:6] Jolene: My goal is to be successful in my field and make a positive impact. I've been studying, attending workshops, and networking to make it happen. Recently, I had the opportunity to present at a virtual conference and received positive feedback.  It was a great experience and confirmed that I'm on the right track.
[D21:7] Deborah: You really put your heart and soul into it. Must have been amazing having it go so well. How did it feel when people gave you positive feedback? Any ideas for what comes next?
[D21:8] Jolene: I was thrilled to receive such positive feedback! It felt so rewarding to know that my efforts were appreciated. Right now, I'm focusing on studying and gaining more experience. I'm even thinking about more internships to further enhance my skills. Exciting times! Hopefully, there will be more updates to share with you soon.
[D21:9] Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Way to go! I'm super proud of all you've achieved. Let me know if you need any help. Onward!
[D21:10] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot to me. 
[D21:11] Deborah: No problem. You got this! 
[D21:12] Jolene:  I'm not giving up, just gonna keep pushing forward.
[D21:13] Deborah: Reach for your goals and don't forget to enjoy the journey. 
[D21:14] Jolene: Thanks, Deb. Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward and remember to enjoy every step of the way.
[D21:15] Deborah: Come on! The journey's as important as the destination. Take time for yourself and find joy in it. We believe in you!
[D21:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a field of sunflowers with a sunset in the background
[D21:16] Jolene: Yeah, you're right! I'll take your advice and find joy on the way. Cheers for the support!
[D21:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a body of water
[D21:17] Deborah: Always by your side!
Session date: 5:33 pm on 26 August, 2023
[D22:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, since we talked I've been thinking about my mom's influence. Remembering those we love is important.
[D22:2] Jolene: I understand, Deb. Remembering and cherishing the memories of our loved ones is so important. It's comforting to know that their influence still guides us. Last Friday, my partner and I talked about how our loved ones have influenced us and what their values meant to us. It was an emotional chat, but it made us feel closer and showed us what really matters. 
[D22:3] Deborah: Those types of conversations really help build relationships. Can you tell me more about the values they have given you?
[D22:4] Jolene: Definitely! Our loved ones have taught us to persevere and stay resilient, like my mom always said to never give up, and my partner's dad showed them to stay determined. Their values have influenced us to pursue our goals, such as me with engineering and my partner with their creative endeavors. Even though they're not here, we both feel their values encouraging us along our paths.
[D22:5] Deborah: That's wonderful to hear, Jolene! It's amazing how their values continue to guide you, even in their absence. It sounds like you and your partner are honoring their memory by pursuing your respective passions. Have you ever considered incorporating those values into your work as well?
[D22:6] Jolene: Yeah, Deborah! We've been figuring out how to add these values into our projects. As an engineering student, I want to use my talents to do good and help solve important problems. I'm keen on coming up with new ideas and making things more efficient to make the world a better place. Going further, my mom stressed the value of helping others and that's something I want to keep in mind for my engineering projects.
[D22:7] Deborah: When our work ties into our values, it becomes more meaningful. What goals or ideas do you have for incorporating those values into your future projects?
[D22:8] Jolene: In the future, I'm aiming to work on projects that make a real difference to communities. I'm interested in sustainable initiatives and developing innovative solutions for environmental issues. I also want to get involved with organizations that focus on social causes, using my skills to help out. It's about connecting my passion for engineering with my commitment to making a positive impact.
[D22:9] Deborah: You've got a lot of amazing plans for the future. Which projects are you most interested in getting involved in?
[D22:10] Jolene: I'm keen on two projects in particular. One is focused on developing renewable energy, like solar, to help communities and reduce dependence on non-renewables. 
[D22:11] Deborah: Wow Jolene, that's really inspiring!
[D22:12] Jolene: The other is finding ways to supply clean water to those with limited access. Both align with my beliefs about sustainability and assisting those in need. I still have so much to figure out before beginning, but I'm up for the challenge.
[D22:13] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! Research is key to success. Little steps and being up for challenges make you stronger. I'm here for you. Connecting to yourself helps tackle any issue. Here's a photo that reminds me of the beauty of nature during a yoga session.
[D22:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D22:14] Jolene: It helps with challenges, giving balance and strength. Any tips for staying relaxed while studying?
[D22:15] Deborah: Taking breaks, doing some stretching/yoga, or just going for a walk is really helpful. And don't forget to get enough sleep and take time for self-care. Finding a balance between work and taking care of yourself is important. What self-care activities have you been doing lately?
[D22:16] Jolene: I've been into yoga and meditation lately. It helps me recharge. Doing different poses relieves tension and calms my mind. I've already shared my newfound love for yoga with my partner, and we're planning to go on a meditation retreat together to enhance our practice together.
[D22:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose
[D22:17] Deborah: Glad to hear that yoga is helping you rest and recharge. It's great for reflection and self-care. Do your snakes also enjoy it?
[D22:18] Jolene: My snakes just like watching me chill. But she's a great company and always brings a sense of calm.
[D22:19] Deborah: Having a pet around is such a calming feeling. They sure can bring a great sense of comfort. I still have cats, Luna is sitting on the left.
[D22:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two cats sitting on a window sill looking out
[D22:20] Jolene: Aww, that's adorable! What's the second one's name?
[D22:21] Deborah: Max! They bring lots of joy and peace to our home.
[D22:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a brown leather chair and a black and white floor
[D22:22] Jolene: How did you get them?
[D22:23] Deborah: Max is my mother's cat, I took him when my mother passed away.
[D22:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a car with a fan and a mesh bag
[D22:24] Jolene: You're great for taming him. How did you get Luna?
[D22:25] Deborah: I took Luna from the shelter.
[D22:26] Jolene: It’s wonderful that you have become their loving owner!
[D22:27] Deborah: Yes, I really love cats, and they also need a home, love, and care! Moreover, Max is already old, he is 8 years old.
[D22:28] Jolene: How old is Luna?
[D22:29] Deborah: She is younger, she is 5 years old.
[D22:30] Jolene: I am proud of your action to tame these pets!

[D23:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, how's it going? Guess what? Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes.
[D23:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose in a mirror
[D23:2] Deborah: That yoga pose looks great. Must've been a cool experience for the two of you. What did the trip teach you?
